function.name: api_request_tool
function.description: Call this the moment a caller reports pain, swelling, redness, heat, discoloration, a lump, vision changes, or difficulty breathing after any treatment. Vision changes or breathing trouble are emergencies. Do not assess severity yourself -- call this tool and read back exactly what it returns.

phone.description: Best callback number for the provider to reach the caller.

description.description: What the caller reported (symptom, treatment, timing). Not required.
